market_definition: The cyanoacrylate adhesives market comprises single-component instant adhesives that polymerise on contact with surface moisture to bond plastics, rubber and metals in seconds. It measures sales of ethyl, methyl, alkoxy-ethyl and specialty grades. BY MONOMER TYPE: Ethyl Cyanoacrylate, Methyl Cyanoacrylate, Alkoxy-Ethyl Cyanoacrylate, Other Cyanoacrylates. BY VISCOSITY: Low-Viscosity, Medium-Viscosity, Gel / High-Viscosity. BY PERFORMANCE GRADE: General Purpose, Rubber-Toughened, Low-Odour / Low-Bloom, Surface-Insensitive. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Automotive & Transportation, Electronics & Electrical, Medical Devices & Wound Closure, Consumer & DIY, Industrial Assembly, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Anaerobic and structural acrylic adhesives; UV-curable adhesives; epoxy adhesives; cyanoacrylate-based nail glue sold as cosmetics. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms. GEOGRAPHY OF THIS LIST: EUROPE - companies headquartered in a European country (EU, United Kingdom, EFTA, Western Balkans, Ukraine, Moldova, Russia).
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
